newsitem.title: USA: Woman dies jumping from apartment fire.
newsitem.headline: Woman dies jumping from apartment fire.

text.p: - A woman jumped to her death as a fast-moving fire swept through a four-story apartment house in West Philadelphia early on Thursday, authorities said.
Five male tenants of the Sherwood Court apartments were injured in escaping the smoke and flames, police said.
Fire Commissioner Harold Hairston said the alarm was sounded about 1:30 a.m. and the blaze was declared under control within 45 minutes.
The speed with which the flames spread led fire authorities to declare the fire as being of suspicious origin.
Red Cross officials said 42 of about 100 tenants, many of them University of Pennsylvania students, had sought assistance. The dead woman's identity was withheld.
